tldr: Sun through the 4th house brings focus to home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Sun transiting the 4th house illuminates home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports home base and inner stability: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or retreating into old patterns.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 4th house deliberately. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
